cards.d: If a plant or animal is aquatic, it lives or grows in water.
cards.e: The dolphin is an aquatic mammal.

cards.d: The biosphere is the earth’s surface and atmosphere where there are living things.
cards.e: Birds, trees, and worms all thrive in the biosphere.

cards.d: When something is bizarre, it is very strange.
cards.e: My bizarre dreams make no sense to me when I am awake.

cards.d: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature.
cards.e: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.

cards.d: If something is coarse, that means it has a rough texture.
cards.e: The coarse sweater made my skin itch.

cards.d: A companion is a person that someone spends a lot of time with.
cards.e: I always walk to school with my companion Frank.

cards.d: To digest means to swallow food and pass it through the body.
cards.e: Allow some time for food to be digested before going swimming.

cards.d: The duration of an event is the time during which it happens.
cards.e: The girls watched television for the duration of the evening.

cards.d: Ecology is the study of the environment and living things.
cards.e: We study ecology to learn how to help improve the Earth.

cards.d: A feat is an impressive or difficult achievement or action.
cards.e: The elephant’s standing up on one leg was a feat.

cards.d: If something is infinite, it has no limit or end.
cards.e: Many scientists believe that the universe is infinite.

cards.d: The nucleus is the central part of an atom or cell.
cards.e: The nucleus is made up of many tiny particles.

cards.d: A parasite is a tiny animal or plant that attaches to another animal to get food.
cards.e: The sick dog was covered in parasites.

cards.d: When something is prominent, it is important and well known.
cards.e: Queen Victoria was a prominent person in history.

cards.d: When something is repetitive, it is repeated many times and becomes boring.
cards.e: Working on an assembly line making cars every day is a repetitive job.

cards.d: If something is reproductive, it has to do with a living thing producing young.
cards.e: The reproductive system of a plant is simple.

cards.d: When a place is temperate, it never gets too hot or cold.
cards.e: In Peru, the weather is temperate and rarely gets too hot or cold.

cards.d: Tolerance is the ability to accept something painful or unpleasant.
cards.e: Boxers have a high tolerance for pain.

cards.d: To undergo an action means to have it happen to you.
cards.e: The cancer patient undergoes treatments twice a week.

cards.d: When someone is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection.
cards.e: He felt very vulnerable when he was stranded in the desert.
